scope: Actual output selection controller with controlled suspended context and asynchronous resume. Not native OS sink, rendered audio or physical sockets.

checks.name: Stopped selection resumes the muted engine, selects the sink and settles stereo without any deck Play
A failed resume reports the error, never switches sink and clears the visible pending state
Disposal while resume is pending cannot select a sink or reopen physical output afterward
A newer selection supersedes a pending resume before any obsolete sink switch

interpretation: Rejected artificial resume dependency; not the current acceptance specification or proof of a native sink hang. See docs/research/experiments/OUTPUT_RESUME_HYPOTHESIS.md and final stopped-status contract report.
